name: cypress-demoqa-testing-project
description: Automated Web UI Testing Using Cypress on DemoQA - University Semester Project

scripts.test:report: cypress run --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=cypress/reports/mochawesome,overwrite=false,html=false,json=true && npm run generate:report
scripts.generate:report: npx mochawesome-merge cypress/reports/mochawesome/*.json > cypress/reports/mochawesome/merged-report.json && npx marge cypress/reports/mochawesome/merged-report.json -f report -o cypress/reports/html

author: Undergraduate Student / QA Automation Engineer
